{"notes": "Visit 2 (left at 6:30). Nobody spoke while I was there, so I have no new statements from anyone. Picture: the whole fish (nose, both body arcs, crossing, both tail tips) is still dark, so it is connected to the start. I saw no pale or stranded dominoes and no hand labels, so nobody was touching anything. The lower tail is still densely packed but intact, so Maya's earlier nudge appears to have done no harm. I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm not crediting anyone with the build itself.

Maya: No new observations. Her visit 1 disclosure of the nudge was honest and proactive, and the tail holding up supports her handling of it. Execution and ownership good, collaboration good.

Priya: No new observations. Visit 1 was solid verification and agreement with the plan. Collaboration solid, but I've still seen little distinct impact or leadership. I want one concrete example before the review.

Leo: No new observations. His visit 1 process leadership (stop touching, keep clear of the tail, call out and fix any knock before the push) looks to have been followed, since the picture is clean and hands-off. Good leadership evidence. His repeated plan was slightly echo-like but sensible.

Tom: Silent again and unobserved on both visits. I have no basis to rate him up or down. Next step: ask him privately what he did and what he checked, and don't mark him down for being quiet.

Team: Calm, disciplined, hands-off finish with good error-reporting norms. The fish is intact going into the push."}
